Params: {3: 'The island heaves violently, and the ocean drops away with the ferocity of a retreating tide.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: "What's happening?! Did the captain pull it off?", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 2: "Oh! Oh—right, right, that's good! ...Wait. No, no, that's not good! Run! Run run run!"}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: "...Wait. No, no, that's not good! Run! Run run run!", 4: '1', 22: '1', 23: '1'}
{3: 'The seawater whips into a violent gyre, roaring with a deep, guttural bellow that rises from the ocean floor.'}
{3: 'A dark funnel hundreds of meters across rips open on the surface, its rim churning with white foam.'}
{3: 'An irresistible force hauls the island downward from its roots, and the reefs along its edges are swallowed whole by the waves.'}
{3: 'The port, the beaches, the lighthouse, all of it disappears into the deep like a giant beast taking its final mouthful.'}
{3: 'The outer rim of the maelstrom grabs hold of the boat. The suction fastens onto the stern and drags at it, and the vessel bucks violently before its speed falls away to almost nothing.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: 'No, no no no no—this is not how the scene is supposed to go!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The hull shudders hard beneath him. Larsen clings to the helm with every ounce of strength he has, but the rudder grows heavier and heavier in his hands.'}
{3: 'The engine screams past its limits, yet the heading swings wildly, skidding toward the heart of the maelstrom.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Don't give up. Keep her running! Every minute you buy is another minute of hope.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Just one moment longer than the last. Just one moment longer.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'With a deafening boom, the port engine overloads and dies, wrenching the boat violently to starboard.'}
{3: 'A second wave broadsides the port beam, flipping the vessel onto its side and catapulting Larsen away from the helm.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'His body hangs halfway over the rail, one hand vised around the steering column, seawater gushing into his throat while a wall of noise consumes his senses.'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Cordelia, you never told me... waiting for hope hurts more than waiting for death...', 4: '1'}

{3: 'All he knows is the heaviness of his own body, the tremor in his hands, the sea tilting wildly before his eyes. The world blurs at the edges. Wind and spray devour his sight, and he closes his eyes, ready to let go.'}
{1: '1', 2: '???', 3: "Larsen, this isn't that broken ship from back then.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'A hand reaches in from behind and closes over his, the one still gripping the helm.'}
{3: 'The hand is cold, all sharp knuckles, with a pale scar running across the webbing between thumb and forefinger. The fish in the polar waters have always been that vicious.'}
{3: 'Through the roar of the sea, those familiar voices reach him again.'}
{2: 'Gunnar', 3: 'No, we were never meant to stand against it.', 4: '15'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: 'But the moment we turn the helm, the moment we raise the sails, the moment we roar back at the sea,', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: 'That which could never be defied has already been defied.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: "Gunnar's hand covers his own. Onni's hand settles over his commander's. Then Sieg's and Lyndae's hands layer on top, one after another."}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: 'This broken wreck of a ship still thrashes on. How ugly and laughable, this last gasp of survival.', 4: '16'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lumi', 3: 'The twilight of the end came yesterday, and it may come again tomorrow.', 4: '4'}
{3: "And then, small and slender, Lumi's hand joins them."}
{2: 'Lumi', 3: 'Sink, then. Sink in the next moment if you must, this last ark of ours.', 4: '4'}
{3: 'One by one, their hands pile on top of each other, all grasping that freezing metal wheel as one.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'My team is in your hands now...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: '【kuroname】', 3: "I'm not leaving her behind. I have to go back. Larsen, this boat is yours now. Be a good captain.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Larsen looks down. The hand gripping the helm grows young again, the skin smoothing over, the scars retreating, the grease stains buried under his nails vanishing.'}
{3: 'These are young hands now. The hands of a Larsen barely past twenty, the one who still lived in hope and poetry.'}
{3: 'A wave slams into his face, icy saltwater gushing down his collar, into his ears, flooding his nose. He does not loosen his grip.'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: '(Sink, then. Sink in the next moment if you must, this last ark of ours.)', 4: '2'}
{3: "The captain stands at the helm, and the crew's voices rise in song above him."}
{3: 'His mind snaps back into sharp focus. One hand wrenches the fuel valve on the starboard engine, forcing every remaining ounce of power to that side.'}
{3: 'The hull heels nearly forty degrees, half the propeller lifting clear of the sea and flinging up a glittering mist that catches the sunlight in a brief, vanishing rainbow.'}
{3: 'Then the bow crests the wave and slams back down onto the water. The suction lets go in an instant, and the boat lunges forward like a hound released from its leash.'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Sink, then. Sink in the next moment if you must, this last ark of ours.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "The captain stands at the helm, and the crew's voices rise in song above him.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'He collapses before the helm, hunched over, his hands hiding his face, and a laugh escapes him.'}
{3: 'It does not stay a laugh for long before turning into a ragged, grieving cry.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: 'I got you out. This time... I got you all out.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Just a group of ordinary people, doing what had to be done. Just a broken vessel, drowning in the waves.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Just a soul as small as candlelight, burning its last light in the sunless deep.'}
{1: 'They stumbled. They failed. Their stories may not shine with grandeur.', 5: '2'}
{1: 'But countless souls like them make history itself.'}
{3: 'Sidkosanatrahk and Sava help Larsen to his feet, and together they turn to look back at the restless sea.'}
{3: 'The buzz of a motor cuts across the water, and they all look toward the sound. A small boat is heading back toward them.'}
{3: 'The maelstrom has spent its rage. There will be no better time to go back.'}
{3: 'The young Engineering Force member lets out a breath of relief.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sava', 3: "(Captain... you'll make it. None of us has given up on each other...)", 4: '18'}
{3: 'A white lifeboat pitches among the swells, its engine throttled low as it circles near the edge of the maelstrom.'}

{3: "The injection of the self-referential paradox packet required synchronization with the lighthouse, so you pulled out of Mannan's body first, planning to regroup once the lighthouse part was complete."}
{3: 'But then Mirage Island groaned from within, its artificial foundation cracking apart, and the girl who promised she would evacuate after entering the key never appeared.'}
{3: "Only when the lifeboat's automated launch sequence activated and it glided to a stop before you did you finally admit the truth. This was Karenina's plan, clumsy and earnest."}
{3: 'Only a timed message waited on your terminal:'}
{1: '11', 2: "<color=#ffffffff><size=40>This is my last wish, my final demand...\\nYou're not allowed to die here.</size></color>", 3: '750', 4: '150', 9: '3', 10: '1', 11: '1'}
{2: "This is my last wish, my final demand... You're not allowed to die here."}
{3: 'Fallen rock and rubble block the way back to the island, the passage completely sealed.'}
{3: "On your terminal, the anchor weapon's control icon still pulses, which means its owner is alive somewhere in this world."}
{3: "As long as there's still a glimmer of hope..."}
{3: 'You brush your fingers lightly over the blinking icon and step aboard the little boat Karenina prepared for you.'}
{3: "Until you see her again, you can only hope the girl doesn't get herself into too much trouble."}
{3: 'Just as Arius is about to slip free of Karenina\'s M.I.N.D., Rarana controls the giant claws and slams them into the "heart" that once belonged to her.'}
{3: 'Karenina\'s final blow to that "heart" destroys the projection\'s only refuge, sealing it deep within her M.I.N.D. with no path of escape left.'}
{3: 'At last, the soul that has won back its own body enters the key that will bring everything to an end.'}
{3: "An unending thunder rolls through the space. With the self-destruct underway, Manann's mind dims and drifts."}
{3: 'The key is entered. Nothing can turn back now.'}
{1: '1', 3: "Karenina rests quietly against that ugly, cold heart. She has sealed Arius' soul inside her M.I.N.D., and within this heart, only one clumsy little crab remains."}
{2: 'Mannan, a stranger to her. Manann, bound to her by fate. Rarana, who will enter the long sleep with her.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Rarana, who will enter the long sleep with her.', 4: '1', 22: '1', 23: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "I'm sorry... Rarana. If only we had met sooner...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'If only I had known it sooner...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'If only White Stork had gotten away safely. If only Cordelia had survived. If only Larsen had never lost her. If only Grandpa had found them. If only they had met again in a kinder fate.'}
{3: 'Among all the pages fate will not revise, this is the best one she could have ever turned to.'}
{3: 'Karenina reaches out and touches the "child" who should have been her family.'}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: 'Where are my flowers? The flowers... Cordelia liked... Kale... Kalerira... help me...'}
{3: 'Rarana gets her name wrong again. Karenina gives a brief laugh, and her fingers tighten in the groove of the metal heart.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "You little dummy, you're not a potted plant anymore.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: "I'm not? But Cordelia... didn't you say you'd put me in the potted plant... so we could leave the ocean together?"}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: 'Are we leaving soon? You said the first stop would be the aquarium... Copperfield Aquarium, right? Did I remember wrong?'}
{3: 'Her fading consciousness finally pulls her back from the edge of despair, sending her to the most important day, when she and Cordelia promised to go to the new world together.'}
{3: 'In the new world, aquariums no longer exist.'}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: 'It hurts... Why does it hurt so much? Mom, where did you go...'}

{3: 'Above the sea, the sun has not yet broken the horizon, but its soft glow already blurs the edges of all devastation. But Mirage Island, descending now into the abyss, is already too deep to be touched by the coming dawn.'}

{3: 'Years ago, this hollow shell, already turned Corrupted, waited through dawn after dawn for someone who would never come back. What little longing remained kept it crying out for its mother in the dark.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'A middle-aged man bound for the moon once came to Corrupted M-1A. It looked at his tired, worn face, and the monster that had lost itself could only manage a few broken words.'}

{3: "All the shades of anguish, all the confusion, the thoughts it cannot grasp, the chaos, the obsessive guilt that tortures it without end... Everything poured through its vocal module, but what reached Kalon's ears was only broken sounds a human could not understand."}
{3: 'And yet, perhaps there was a kind of mercy in this. The ones who should have been        "family," the most intimate strangers, were at least granted a glimpse of each other.'}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: 'Did you find her? The seabed to the surface... so far... too dangerous... she...'}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: "No! That's wrong! She lied... she lied to me... she li—"}
{3: "A child's scream tears from her throat."}
{3: 'Karenina holds the hideous heart tight and forces herself to speak gently, the way a reliable big sister would comfort her younger sibling.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I found her, Rarana... I found her, and I found you... It's alright now. It's alright.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'We can... go now. We can go to the new world.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "A new world where everyone's together... Grandpa, Cordelia, you, me... Wise, White Stork... all of us, together.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Sorry I took so long... but I found you all.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Arius\' struggle inside her M.I.N.D. weakens by the second. After all, what remains here is only a "projection," stripped away through a Sefirah and the Ascension-Network.'}
{3: 'A "small" price is all it takes to erase it completely.'}
{3: 'Death is only another journey, and Karenina does not fear it.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'A theory says that the universe was just a lifeless singularity before it exploded and created everything beautiful! So the greatest power of all is actually explosions.', 4: '1'}
{3: "She repeats her grandfather's words again, and for reasons she cannot name, she smiles."}
{3: 'Karenina chooses the way she knows best and detonates her own M.I.N.D.'}
{3: 'The heart gives a single, violent jolt.'}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: 'Karenina... bearing pain and accepting loss... is it something you have to learn to become human?'}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: "It hurts so much... but I'm so happy."}
{3: 'Not for the death looming ahead, but for a reunion that arrived far too late, and for all she must now bid farewell.'}
{3: 'Her voice shakes in pain. The heart no longer beats.'}
{3: "A thunderous roar fills the air as the monster's body begins to break apart. A soul that was never whole finds its release at last."}
{3: "Fire rages through Karenina's M.I.N.D., and Arius laughs wildly in the flames. The inferno that burns the devil will burn Karenina too, down to everything she is."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Commandant, dying for everyone like this... I should feel happy about it, right?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "But why... why the tears won't stop...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Her consciousness sinks into a blazing sea of fire.'}
{3: 'Strangely, the fire brings no agony. It pulls her gently downward, drawing her into another space entirely.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Rarana', 3: 'Karenina, more than being together, what I want is for you to be happy.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: "I understand now... Leaving you behind, even though it hurts... it's my selfish love.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: "I couldn't ask you first. So I chose for you, a road that leads to your happiness.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: "Goodbye, Karenina... I'm going to see Mom now. That's the road to my happiness.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Every step she takes from that moment forward leads her toward their reunion.'}
{3: 'Before the inferno can devour everything, the sea surges in.'}
{3: 'The endless roar of the tide carries the sharp Atlantic air, welcoming her back to where she belongs, just as it once welcomed her into the world.'}
{3: 'White foam piles like snowdrifts, lacing the little reef island in a frothing skirt. The caw of ravens echoes from somewhere unseen, each cry finding her ears.'}
{3: 'The sun hovers at the edge of the horizon. She stands on the shore, and the grey-blue waves that have traveled from the seam of sea and sky lap gently over her bare feet.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'They are the feet of a child. Her body has become that of a six- or seven-year-old, back when she was nothing more than an ordinary human girl.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Karenina, don't stand barefoot in the seawater. You'll catch a cold.", 4: '18'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Come put your socks and shoes on.', 4: '18'}
{3: "The woman's voice is achingly familiar. She has heard it humming lullabies, heard it breaking into wails, heard it speaking a farewell that was restrained and full of warmth."}
{3: 'She has never truly seen her face.'}
{3: 'Karenina does not turn around. Not until a small, cold hand slips into hers.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Karenina sees a face both strange and deeply familiar. The girl glances toward her family in the distance, then sticks out her tongue and pulls a silly face.'}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: "You're in trouble now. Mom's gonna be so mad.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Karenina, don't say I didn't warn you. I'll count to three. Three... two... one.", 4: '18'}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: "Don't worry. I'm Mom's favorite. I'll talk her around. It'll be okay.", 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 3: 'At last Karenina turns her head, and her eyes find what has been waiting behind her all along. Near the reef, a drawing board and paint stand rest quietly. Paintbrushes soak in a bucket of water, and a canvas folding chair cradles an old man whose features are gentle but impossible to focus on.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Without warning, Cordelia drops her brush into the bucket, crushes a spoiled draft into a tight ball, and flings it at Kalon.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Another explosion? The basement this time? Dr. Kalon, how many times has it been? Every experiment ends like this. Can't you set a good example for the children?", 4: '15'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Watching that lively expression, it dawns on Karenina that Rarana wears the face of Cordelia as a little girl. Her lips part, words rising but not yet spoken.'}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: "Not listening! I'm Mom's favorite. You don't count.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Karenina does not shake off that chilly little hand. Instead, she squeezes it gently, holding on a little tighter.'}
{3: 'This is Rarana\'s "dream." She once looked like an animal, spent long years as a plant, and was never once granted a single human moment.'}
{3: 'So in this "dream," she chooses to wear her mother\'s form.'}
{1: '1', 3: "Karenina swipes at the wetness gathering at her lashes and presses her brow to Rarana's."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'You little dummy! Grandpa looked like this...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Rarana has never met Kalon, so his face always lingers in the backlight, his features soft and indistinct.'}

{3: 'Though childhood, even for Karenina, was brief and barren as a half-remembered dream, she still wants to share the precious warmth she holds in her memory with the girl standing before her.', 4: '15'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "(It's alright. I'll tell you. The warm things, the happy things... I'll share them all with you.)", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Rarana stares blankly at Karenina, her face not yet knowing how to form finer, more complicated expressions.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Karenina sees Kalon get up from his chair and fall into step behind Cordelia, both of them approaching.'}
{3: 'Just the way she remembers. Just the way he came to her in the long dreams of so many nights.'}

{1: '1', 3: "Rarana's fingers slip free, and she rockets into Cordelia's waiting arms like a small, fierce projectile. Kalon raises a hand and brushes Rarana's brow with the same tenderness Karenina remembers."}
{3: 'Grandfather, Cordelia, Rarana. This dream is spun from the memories two souls have stitched together.'}
{3: 'This is the little sister, Mom, and Grandpa I could have had.'}
{3: 'This is the home I was meant to have.'}
{3: "The world brightens at last. A raven glides through the sky, and the sea breeze and sunlight slip through its feathers, soft as happiness combed fine, settling gently against Karenina's cheek."}
{3: 'The gray-blue water gleams beneath the sun, a vast sea of cornflower petals stretching endlessly.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Cordelia walks over to her, tilts her head, and studies her from head to toe, then lets out a dissatisfied little sigh.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Grandpa bends down, strokes her hair, and asks the same question she heard countless times when she was small.'}
{2: 'Kalon', 3: 'And what else does our little Karenina want to do?', 4: '2'}
{3: 'This time, no longer a child, she knows exactly where her heart wants to go.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'I want to be someone useful, someone who makes the world better.', 4: '3'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'I want the name you gave me to shine like the stars.', 4: '3'}
{3: 'Cordelia kneels to her level and meets her eyes. Her gaze holds no grand emotion, nothing complicated. She simply looks at her, steady and soft, with all her attention.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'But most of all, become someone who can find happiness for herself.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Someone who can find happiness... for herself.', 4: '15'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Karenina, you just made a hard choice... A sacrifice, really.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "I'm not sure anyone has told you this, so I will. It was never yours to carry, but someone had to. And you did. You are our hero, child.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'My little Karenina, you gave yourself for this, and that is what makes you who you are.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Everything you gave away was seeds. One day, they will grow into the life you live.', 4: '1'}
{3: "She reaches out and softly tucks the loose strands of hair behind Karenina's ear."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Karenina, you've grown into such a kind and wonderful girl. I'm so happy to see it.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Karenina says nothing. She throws herself into the woman's arms."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Can you keep at it? Always be kind and happy, okay?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Still held in her arms, Karenina nods with quiet solemnity.'}
{3: 'Everyone she has ever met, everything she has ever lived through, has shaped her into the kind and wonderful Karenina she is now.'}
{3: 'And she will stay that way, always.'}
{3: "She strokes the girl's hair with quiet, aching fondness."}
{3: "Rarana drops her hands from her eyes, darts around Cordelia, and pushes a golden energy component into Karenina's palm."}
{3: "It's the external backup energy core that belonged to Cordelia."}
{3: 'Karenina looks down at the tiny golden star, its light soft and faint in her palm.'}
{3: 'She tightens her fist around the little stone.'}
{3: "The raven's cry has stopped without her noticing. It perches now on a little boat that has come from somewhere unknown, head cocked, watching her."}
{3: 'Karenina steps into the sea and wades toward the little boat that will carry her back to reality.'}

{3: 'The snow starts falling again, heavy and silent, as though it means to bury this dream forever. She turns back, once, then again, and finally she cannot hold it in. She opens her mouth and shouts.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Grandpa! Cordelia! Did I... grow up the way you hoped?'}
{2: 'Kalon', 3: 'Little Karenina, you never had to grow up the way anyone hoped.'}
{3: 'To grow is to break yourself open, to tear yourself down, over and over, until at last you become who you truly are. This is the grandest adventure of all.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "You have become yourself. That's the most remarkable thing anyone can do."}

{3: 'Karenina boards the little boat. The raven settles on her shoulder, lending her the wisdom to return to the waking world. She keeps her eyes forward, no longer looking back at her family standing in the snow.'}
{3: 'Her family protected her. The explosion inside her M.I.N.D. has blasted away every sinful remnant of the past and left only the girl called Karenina.'}
{3: "She is no one's test subject now. From this moment forward, she is just Karenina."}
{3: 'The universe started with a big explosion. Every element, everything that makes up all of this world, came from that single moment.'}
{3: 'That grand beginning shapes every one of us, the ordinary and the extraordinary alike.'}
{3: 'When the poet speaks of all the waters of the world finding one another again, we, born from distant stars, have already fulfilled that promise across the eons.'}
{3: 'The golden energy component hums in her hand, a sound like a horn calling her soul back to her body.'}
{3: 'She opens her eyes once more and finds herself back in the world of the living.'}
{3: 'Her feeble consciousness can barely command her spent frame, and everything growing heavy and slow devours every spark of hope.'}
{3: 'The surface, impossibly close, does not draw nearer no matter how many times her frame strains toward it.'}
{3: 'Karenina can no longer measure time or distance. The world around her seems to stay the same, unmoving.'}
{3: "And then, as if from nowhere, Rarana's voice finds her again."}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: 'Karenina, you still have a place to go back to. There are still people you want to see.'}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: 'Just hang in there a little longer, okay?'}
{3: 'The surface stays just as far away, never letting her draw closer. Only the tiny fragments sinking past her in the water prove that her struggle is not meaningless.'}
{3: "Rarana's enormous body casts a shadow across the seafloor as Cordelia's deep dive pod sinks slowly past her."}
{1: 'In the instant her power curve is about to drop to zero, the energy system deep within her frame catches a faint beacon signal.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'It comes from an external module—the backup energy core. Its emergency supply port is still active. Her power system reaches out, offering a tentative handshake.'}
{1: 'In the next heartbeat, fresh power floods every corner of her frame, driving her at full speed, lifting her through the endless deep. Upward, upward.', 5: '1', 7: '1'}
{1: 'The life that was devoured in this place left behind her final energy,\\nand now she reaches out in another form to embrace the child once held so close, then lost for so long.', 3: '45'}
{2: 'The life that was devoured in this place left behind her final energy, and now she reaches out in another form to embrace the child once held so close, then lost for so long.'}
{1: 'She lifts Karenina past the crushing deep, toward a place she herself could never return to.', 3: '45'}
{2: 'She lifts Karenina past the crushing deep, toward a place she herself could never return to.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "There... there's still... people I want to see... the world... I want to go back to..."}
{3: 'And still, the deep is so terribly deep. How many lives has it swallowed into its darkest reaches?'}
{1: '"The deep is an endless silence. It devours the light, yet remembers every star that falls into it."', 3: '45'}
{2: '"The deep is an endless silence. It devours the light, yet remembers every star that falls into it."'}
